mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand expansion, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1050.0 and RSAFS > 440000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior rise above 105.0, signals a manufacturing contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO > 105.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, signals inflationary pressure that may prompt future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC > 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, following a prior expansion above 2.0%, signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 142,000 signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 142000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 142000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC > 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0%, indicates a dual stress on supply and labor markets, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE > 5.0 in the prior month
regime_hint: dual stress regime (supply and labor contraction)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances, or interaction Rank IC > -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
